headline: This short law extends the National Flood Insurance Program's authorization through December 7, 2018.
what_it_does: The National Flood Insurance Program lets property owners buy federally backed flood insurance. Without an extension, its authority would expire, so this law keeps it running for a short additional period. The official summary describes only this one change to the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968.

who_it_affects.group: People who hold or buy flood insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program
who_it_affects.how: Their coverage can continue under the program while its authorization is extended through December 7, 2018.

who_it_affects.group: Communities that take part in the National Flood Insurance Program
who_it_affects.how: Their participation in the program can continue during the extension period.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 1, 2018; the program's authorization runs through December 7, 2018.
